svg.title: Antonio's pocket universe
svg.desc: Six original storybook planets travel on elliptical orbits around the smiling star Sol-0. Qubit-9 carries a cat moon, Foundria a robot, Nimbus-7 a satellite, Gitopia a cargo cube, Pixelune a camera, and Copilotia a rocket. Each planet also spins on its own axis. Motion pauses when reduced motion is requested. The landing pads below the illustration open the projects.

g.text: PLEASE KEEP YOUR WAVEFUNCTION INSIDE THE UNIVERSE.
